programme.desc: A 40-ton lorry rammed full of scrap metal overturns and spills its steel load across a major A road during rush hour, and Lantern recovery op Steve Knight is called to the scene. It's a job that will push Steve and his team to the limit.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Father and son Dave and Adam Crouch team up to save a lorry transporting a train from sinking into soft ground. Crouch Recovery Op Jim has to rescue a lorry from a ditch after the driver attempted an ill-advised three-point turn.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Simon has to grapple with a juggernaut that has skidded off the M62 and down a steep bank, but when they finally manage to pull it back onto the carriageway, it starts leaking diesel.

programme.title: Plymouth AAR ‘Cuda & Challenger T/A
programme.desc: Chrysler Corporation turned their 340 ‘Cudas and Challengers into world-class road racers, and muscle car fans lined up at Chrysler's showrooms for a chance to take them to the streets!

programme.title: American Motors AMX
programme.desc: One of the greatest supercars ever built, and the first two-seat sports car built since the Corvette and the early T-Bird. Close to ten thousand of these lightning-fast cars stuffed a lot of wisecracks about Ramblers being slow and boring!

programme.title: Buick Regal GNX
programme.desc: Buick quietly re-entered the supercar wars in the late eighties with a turbocharged 3.8-liter V-6 engine in an all-black Regal. The car was so outrageously fast that it's now among the most collectible cars of all time.

programme.title: '55-'57 Chevrolet Bel Air
programme.desc: Many people say this is where the muscle car era began. The '55 Chevy was Chevrolet's opening into the world of auto performance. These cars changed America's automotive landscape, and today they're still the most popular collector cars in the world.

programme.title: Phi Alpha Fail
programme.desc: Carlos goes undercover at a frat house, but when the party gets the best of him Sonia has to step in and fight the drunken mob. Matt and Ronnie go after some wanna-be internet sensations.

programme.title: Minority Report: sentencia previa
programme.desc: Minority Report es sobre un policía del futuro que trabaja en una división del departamento de policía arrestando asesinos antes de que cometan crímenes, gracias a una avanzada tecnología de premoniciones.

programme.title: Terminator 2: juicio final
programme.desc: La máquina no humana que domina la élite del futuro devastado por la guerra despacha un cíborg asesino al pasado para matar a un jovencito porque pronto será el líder de la resistencia en contra de la máquina.

programme.title: La estafa maestra

programme.title: Leanne Morgan
programme.desc: Leanne Morgan exudes southern charm. She is a naturally funny storyteller who gives an honest look at suburban life and the challenges of keeping her husband happy while juggling kids, dogs and cheerleading camp at the same time she's racing to get her hair highlighted, have a colonoscopy and join weight watchers for the 7th time! Leanne will take you on a hilarious journey through motherhood and beyond as she finds comedy amidst the chaos.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: A one-of-a-kind delivery accompanied by impeccable timing and imaginative comedy angles has led DAVE DUGAN down the path to NATIONAL TV APPEARANCES and to RAVE REVIEWS from corporate event planners.

programme.title: Mark Christopher Lawrence
programme.desc: Mark Christopher Lawrence (born May 22, 1964) is an American character actor, stand-up comedian, and voice-over artist. He is perhaps best known for his role as esoteric D.J., Tone Deaf, in the 1994 satirical rap mockumentary, Fear of a Black Hat. He has co-starred in popular films such as Terminator 2: Judgment Day, Planet of the Apes, Lost Treasure and The Pursuit of Happiness. Lawrence can currently be seen in his regular role as Big Mike on the NBC series Chuck. He has made guest appearances on many television programs, most notably Heroes, My Name Is Earl, Crossing Jordan, Dharma & Greg, Malcolm in the Middle, Touched by an Angel, Malcolm & Eddie, Men Behaving Badly, Seinfeld, Murphy Brown, and Martin. He is also featured on the Radio Series Adventures in Odyssey as "Ed Washington".

programme.title: Brad Stine
programme.desc: Brad Stine is the most media-covered Christian comedian in the country. He had an 8-page profile written about him and his comedy in the New Yorker magazine where he was referred to as Gods Comic.Brad was a regular live social commentator on Fox & Friends every Monday morning for six months.He has been featured in the New York Times, Christian Science Monitor, Los Angeles Times, Wall Street Journal, and USA Today. He has been featured on NBC Nightly News, HBO, Showtime, CNN, Glenn Beck, Hannity and Colmes, NPRS Fresh Air, ABC Nightline, MTV, and Comedy Central. He has had material published in Readers Digest and Focus on the Family magazine.He has five original DVDs featuring his comedy, and has written two books, Live from Middle America Rants from a Red-State Comedian, published by Hudson Street Press and Being a Christian Without Being an IdiotHe has appeared in numerous films including Poodle Springs on HBO, Welcome to Paradise, Sarahs Choice, Christmas With a Capital C, and Covering Your Tracts. He tours nationally on a regular basis performing in clubs, churches, and fundraisers for Crisis pregnancy centers, ministries and conservative causes and candidates.The New Yorker magazine stated that Brads style is frantic, aggressive, and caustic, with echoes of Robin Williams, Sam Kinison, and George Carlin, who is his comedy hero.

programme.title: K-Von
programme.desc: Half-Persian and raised in a religious family, K-Von's comedy unites sharp cultural riffs with clean delivery. In this special he takes on political correctness, cyber bullying, and the utility of cargo pants.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: As a mother of seven, Chelle T has seen it all, and shes not afraid to joke about it. Quippy and honest, Chelle T talks about how children are raised differently these days, menopause, being married for twenty-three years, and how desperate you sometimes become when youre a mom in this special.

programme.title: Mike Guido
programme.desc: Mike Guido has made his mark as a nationally known headlining comedian. He has made eight national TV appearances including SHOWTIME, A&E, MTV, and VH1 and has worked with some of today's biggest stars such as Jay Leno, Robin Williams, and Ellen Degenneres.

programme.title: Andy Woodhull
programme.desc: The hilarious comedian Andy Woodhull quips on learning to lie, thinking that monsters might be real, and running late for the movies. In this compelling Dry Bar Comedy special, Andy also talks about the mystery of the candy wrapper and the amazing toast bar.

programme.title: Cory Michaelis
programme.desc: A teacher by day and comic by night, Cory Michaelis keeps his act edgy enough to keep the audience from feeling like they're in his 10th grade History class. He cleverly tells short stories and jokes that try to get audiences to think but are silly and absurd as well. Cory is a regular in all of the clubs in the Pacific Northwest and has headlined clubs, colleges, casinos, and weird bars all over the country. He didn't win the 2013 World Series of Comedy (semi-finals), the 2012 Seattle International Comedy Competition (SICC), or the 2014 Tacoma Comedy Contest (2nd) but he took another crack at the SICC and made the 2014 finals.

programme.title: Súper Shore
programme.desc: La relación entre Igor y Talía cada vez se hace más intensa y amorosa y por supuesto esto a Arantxa no le cae nada bien y la pone en un lugar caliente, llevando la tensión a toda la casa

programme.title: Súper Shore
programme.desc: Todos contra todos, Electra y Arantxa atacan a Igor, el brasileño ataca a Electra, la casa es un revuelo y encima llega visita que se pone demasiado pesada.

programme.title: Súper Shore
programme.desc: La situación de Talía e Igor no estaría siendo la mejor. No hablar con Arantxa la lleva a quedar expuesta porque la española toma la iniciativa y le dice sus verdades.

programme.title: Súper Shore
programme.desc: Kyle y Chloe de Geordie Shore llegan a Súper Shore y hacen historia al llegar a la casa de sorpresa para pasar unos días con los chicos. Los Ingleses muestran por qué son tan respetados y agarran fiesta muy duro.

programme.title: Súper Shore
programme.desc: Fernando está en crisis, peleado y distanciado de todos, incluso sus amigos de Acapulco Shore. Ya ha tenido cruces con Potro, Abraham, Igor, Mane y Esteban. Mientras tanto Electra y Esteban deberán trabajar juntos en el bar de la playa.

programme.title: Súper Shore
programme.desc: Llega una sorpresa enorme para Potro que lo pondrá en jaque y en un triángulo amoroso en el que no esperaba estar. Y el resto de la casa sigue tenso aún con la partida de Fernando.

programme.title: Catfish Colombia
programme.desc: Karem conoció a Juan David porque una amiga de ella los presentó virtualmente. Después de muchos meses de amistad virtual, decidieron convertirse en pareja a distancia.

programme.title: Catfish México
programme.desc: Durante casi 2 años Carlos ha mantenido una relación amorosa en línea con Luci, la mujer de su vida y está desesperado por conocerla en persona. Ella es una chica muy ocupada, aun así, lo ha apoyado en los momentos más difíciles de su vida.

programme.title: La venganza de los ex: Caribe

programme.title: La venganza de los ex: Caribe
programme.desc: Lua, la ex de Gabriel, llega a la playa. Gab y Angietta queman a JV, pero a Lua no le importa y los dos se enrollan mucho en una cita. Camila y Ortega rompen. La tablet les convoca a un Luau donde llega Julio, el ex novio de Mari A.

programme.title: La venganza de los ex: Caribe
programme.desc: Al ver llegar a su ex, Mari A se preocupa por Ortega. Mario y Apolo se pelean por Let. Ortega se derrumba ante la llegada de su ex. La tablet regala la suite a Camila. Let recoge a Gabriel y Ortega y Mariana se ponen al día bajo el edredón.

programme.title: Deadly Australians

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Hired to defend an innocent newscaster, Matlock is baffled until evidence turns up that puts him on the trail of the real killer.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Joining forces with an old friend and adversary, Julie March, Matlock attempts to reverse a murder sentence and unravel a case of corruption, conspiracy, and perjury.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: When a successful country music star is murdered, the promoter she fired – Steve Fisher – becomes the logical suspect.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: When an Assistant District Attorney is murdered, Matlock is asked to switch sides and act as Special Prosecutor for the state of Georgia.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Matlock’s investigation as the state’s Special Prosecutor uncovers a judicial conspiracy involving two judges and a corporate lawyer.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Matlock’s faith in his ability as a top-notch attorney is completely eroded when he’s dismissed by a client and replaced by a younger lawyer.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: During his fishing trip, Matlock encounters the small, unfriendly town of Lone Pine as he attempts to solve the mysterious death of a young farmhand and uncover a town-wide cover-up.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Director of an amateur stage production, Doug Michaels fires would-be actor Ben Matlock from his role as a detective, claiming he’s seen kumquats with more talent. However, the tables soon turn when Michaels is accused of murdering the leading lady.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Matlock suffers a series of mishaps when he tries to find a missing murder witness to clear his client, who’s accused of killing her philandering husband.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Matlock’s client, a hot blues singer and compulsive gambler, is accused of murdering his boss/bookmaker, but Matlock discovers that a lot of people wanted the victim dead.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Defending a compulsive gambler accused of killing his bookie, Matlock uncovers an unsolved I5-year-old art theft and murder, as well as a blackmail scheme that followed the crime.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Political cartoonist Ronald Winfield is murdered when he exposes a Senator’s infidelity through his comic strip.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Matlock must overcome his dislike of a caustic radio personality and defend him when he is accused of killing a rival disk jockey.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Beware of the black widow! A jealous girlfriend is a dangerous woman and Ray, one half of the popular Rick & Ray radio talk show, has the bullets in his chest to prove it! Now Matlock must get the evidence he needs to convict, but it won’t be easy.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Ben Matlock gives his assistant, Michelle Thomas, her toughest courtroom assignment... breaking down the eyewitness testimony of a former law classmate in a brutal murder case.

programme.title: Rich Intent
programme.desc: 16-year-old Quana yearns to go to her very first concert. When she gets the opportunity to see her favorite artist, her dreams quickly spiral into a horrific nightmare of imprisonment and shady deals.

programme.title: Restraining Order
programme.desc: A married woman of 10 years, longs for a life of luxury and opulence. An old flame begins to catch her eye as a means to fulfill that dream, at the cost of her jealous husband. He begins to cause a storm of terror, where she fears for her safety.

programme.title: The Queens Court
programme.desc: The Queens Court is an underground, all female organization that rules on all criminal activity in the city. Nothing is done without the queens courts verdict first, and those who fail to comply will be dealt with, by any means necessary.

programme.title: The Perfect Wife
programme.desc: A young freelance photographer in Houston meets a beautiful determined teacher from Atlanta. His best friend tries to warn him about her. There is something a little strange about Claudia. Q loves her dearly but she may not be The Perfect Wife.

programme.title: The Perfect Wife 2
programme.desc: The Styles Girls relocate to a new state to start over after the loss of the only place they knew. Unbeknownst to them, the secrets they left behind surface within the walls of their new residence.

programme.title: The Only Child
programme.desc: Twelve-year old Chris has a wonderful and thriving childhood with her loving family. When her mother dies tragically in a car accident, she begins to go down a dark spiral. When Chris’ father starts seeing another woman, she begins a sinister plan, as no woman will ever replace her mother.

programme.title: Legends of the Highway
programme.desc: Follow the true story of the Florida Highwaymen, 26 self-taught African American artists who forged their own path to success in the segregated 1950’s and 60’s. Their stories are guided by the mentorship of renowned landscape painters A.E. Backus, Alfred Hair, and Harold Newton. Their troupe captured Florida’s breathtaking landscapes and sold their paintings along state highways, circumventing the traditional art world that excluded them.

programme.title: Waiting to Process
programme.desc: Four friends—DeShea, Liz, Raven, and Devine—are bound by sisterhood but challenged by the men in their lives. DeShea dates a man with ties to her family, Liz's boyfriend is immature, Raven juggles multiple men, and Devine's husband has a mistress who becomes a deadly threat. As secrets and betrayals test their loyalties, the women must decide if their friendship can survive the chaos.

programme.title: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Blake, a man on the verge of marriage who becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of deception and revenge orchestrated by his vengeful ex, London. As their past resurfaces, he is forced to confront hidden secrets and navigate London's sinister manipulations, leading to explosive confrontations and heart-pounding suspense.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: Deadly Surrogate
programme.desc: When a young married couple suffer the pain of infertility, they look to the path of surrogacy and come upon Alana as a potential candidate. As the three become intertwined, tensions begin to unravel and threaten to consume them.

programme.title: Blind Tiez
programme.desc: Naire is on the up and up as he’s recently promoted to be the youngest detective in the police department. When one of his cases goes completely wrong, he stands accused of murder, and must race to clear his name.

programme.title: Queens of Dope City
programme.desc: Joselyn, Kendra and Alicia are partners in a rideshare service they have created together, but are struggling financially to maintain the business. One day Joselyn gives a man named Donte a ride who presents her with an opportunity to keep the business going. Things then begin to spiral out of control when they soon are chased down from the law, and must escape Donte.

programme.title: Lot Lizards 2: Revenge Route
programme.desc: Destitute and desperate, China is forced to the edge, taking up work as a truck stop sex worker just to survive. Into this grim reality storms Ze, who has come to town seeking vengeance on Angie's sister—the woman who murdered his brother, Tez. But Ze's plans are bigger than just revenge: he aims to rally and recruit every woman working the highway.

programme.title: Sneaky Links
programme.desc: Tammy, a popular social media influencer, has a high libido, and loves a variety of men. When Tammy’s frenemy, Megan, gets wind of Tammy’s slutty ways, her engagement to Jewelz, a high profile professional athlete, is at stake.

programme.title: Street Dreams: Los Angeles
programme.desc: After a traumatic event that takes the life of a young Elijah Wilkins' childhood friend, Elijah meets an FBI agent that sets him on the right path. He vows to indirectly avenge his friend's death by becoming an undercover cop for the LAPD with hopes of working his way into the counterintelligence division of the FBI. When he stumbles upon a case involving domestic terrorism, Elijah sees this case as the perfect opportunity that could possibly usher him in the FBI, but not without risking it all.

programme.title: Suffocated: Room to Breathe
programme.desc: Lexxy wants it all: money, love, kids, a home. She has got the drive, now all she needs is the path. After a stint as a party promoter and criminal, she turns to the music business. Lexxy forms a female hip hop group, with dreams of breaking into the industry. Things look promising until lies and betrayal break up the group, and dissolve all friendships.

programme.title: Reality TV Murders
programme.desc: In the world of reality TV, Chasity Safire is a household name and has been the star of the hugely popular reality TV show “Diva’s Doing it” for the past 5 years. When one of the castmates is found dead, the women become suspects and we discover that some of the women would literally kill to be famous.

programme.title: Tethered Hearts
programme.desc: Token is a charismatic club owner who’s inherited his father’s iconic jazz club, and uses it at a sanctuary for the broken and struggling artists. When a shady music executive starts to recruit his talent, he fights to keep his club afloat.

programme.title: The Laundry Room Stalker
programme.desc: A string of murders on local neighborhood sex workers have been occurring around one specific apartment building’s laundry room. But all suspicion points to the newly hired attendant, Calvin who was just released from prison for 12 years.

programme.title: Trouble
programme.desc: As Draven faces financial ruin and a serious illness, her marriage to Adam frays. She reconnects with Ceceilius, a wealthy ex, finding comfort in his stability. But as their romance blossoms, Adam’s jealousy spirals into a dangerous obsession, fueled by terrifying dreams and a mysterious woman, Robin. With a wedding on the horizon and secrets unraveling, love and betrayal collide, leading to a shocking conclusion where nothing is as it seems.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Crash Out
programme.desc: An up-and-coming podcast starts to take off, they land an exclusive interview with a controversial wellness guru. But when an on-air confrontation begins to escalate, the effects of his own product begin to take over with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Widower Syndrome
programme.desc: Following a near-fatal car accident a year ago, Xavier and his wife Amanda, take their daughter on a road trip hoping for a family reset. After a pit stop, Amanda and Alexandria disappear, and everyone is convinced he came to the park alone. A race of desperation to find the truth, may also reveal Xavier’s own sanity.

programme.title: More Than Friends
programme.desc: When Angela, a heterosexual, learns her friend, Tennille, loves her, she is surprised to find that she may feel the same.

programme.title: 3 Way Poly
programme.desc: A young couple's experiment in intimacy spirals into a nightmare when they invite a seductive stranger into their home. Little do they know, she's a killer on the loose, and their lives hang by a thread

programme.title: Three Secrets
programme.desc: Struck with the grief after losing her child, Naomi is stuck in a depression while her husband begins to stray from their marriage. Hoping to bring life back into their boring marriage, he invites her to go out with him and they meet a mysterious woman who joins them for the evening. As events unfold She finds herself in an unexpected entanglement built on lies.

programme.title: Trapped in the Game
programme.desc: Polo is a young desperate hustler looking to make some quick cash. However, the only way he knows how to make cash quickly, is pimping out young women with the help of his crew. When of his crew starts taking girls off the street, the heat threatens to bring down his whole operation.

programme.title: My Man
programme.desc: Trina, a young model, becomes entangled with the charming Max. As their relationship deepens, she uncovers his dark secrets: a double life, a psychotic ex-girlfriend, and a dangerous obsession. When Trina crosses a line, she becomes the target of a deadly game of cat and mouse. Betrayal, madness, and murder ensue as the lines between love, obsession, and survival blur.

programme.title: ToxiCity
programme.desc: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order. A night out leads him to Sierra, an alluring actress who quickly moves in. Their romance sours as Sierra's past as a dancer and her aggressive jealousy come to light.

programme.title: Contusion
programme.desc: Terry and his grandmother enjoy a life of peace and harmony, until one night when a group of thieves invade their home. As he navigates from the aftermath, he must confront whether justice will prevail or whether darkness will consume everything he holds dear.

programme.title: Your Man Will be Mine
programme.desc: Fed up with her neglectful boyfriend Cory, Raina seizes a golden opportunity when he’s arrested by stealing his bail money and vanishes. Seeking refuge with her cousin Jessica, Raina’s survival instinct takes a dark turn as she is tempted by Jessica’s boyfriend, hoping to secure a new life. But when Cory unexpectedly busts out of jail and comes hunting for his cash, Raina must choose love or survival.

programme.title: Baddies Revenge
programme.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: El doctor llama a Magdalena y le confirma que la junta consultiva ha decidido entregarle la información que ella pidió. Gabriel le ofrece acompañarla a buscar el sobre. Cuando llegan a la clínica, el doctor plantea que hay un inconveniente, y Agustín aparece, para explicar que a él no le habían pedido su permiso, como padre legal de Rodrigo. El doctor resuelve en dejar que Agustín decida si se abre el sobre o no, y él no deja que Magdalena sepa la verdad. - Ella se va triste, junto a Gabriel, y él la consuela. Epi se infiltra en la casa de Julieta vestido de mujer, haciéndose pasar por amiga de Ana Belén. Allí logra conseguir un cuaderno de Julieta, y luego se da a la fuga, dejando inclusive un zapato, el que luego Ana Belén sospecha que es de Valentina.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín es extraditado tras las amenazas de muerte hacia Ricardo. Elizabeth, sumida en el dolor por la muerte de Celia, decide mudarse con su padre pese a la presencia de Katiuska, pero sufre una preocupante hemorragia nasal. Por otro lado, María del Pilar asegura que su hijo es de Marcelo ante la presión de Gustavo. Mientras Marcelo busca el divorcio de Graciela, Misael continúa profesando su amor por Manuela en medio de tensiones familiares y planes de venganza.

programme.title: Episodio 99
programme.desc: Los delincuentes liberan a Leticia tras el secuestro. Eustoquio se roba los documentos del Hato de Perijá del despacho de Rivero. Adolfo botará a Vilma de la empresa al descubrir que ordenó el secuestro. Erasto humilla a Natalia, ya completamente borracho, obligándola a desnudarse y bailar, y le habla a Natalia como si fuera Consuelo, revelando su obsesión. Eustoquio visita a Consuelo exigiendo su parte de la herencia como hijo de Erasto. Marisela bebe con Isaías. Alejandro sorprende a Rosa al regresar y le confiesa todo su amor.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Gina provoca a Clemencia para que le diga la verdad sobre Luis Francisco Vilarte, acusándola de que eran amantes. Le pregunta sobre las cartas que guardaba de él, pero Clemencia no le dice nada, en cambio la golpea y Gina reacciona fuerte contra ella. Más tarde, Gina le cuenta a su padre Augusto sobre esto, y lo intenta hacer recapacitar sobre la infidelidad de Clemencia. Augusto se niega a escuchar sus palabras y le dice que ella no es lo suficientemente madura como para esos temas.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cristóbal se reconcilia con Ana y ponen otra vez fecha de boda. Carlota va a visitar a Conrado y de paso le da una mano a Mireya con el aseo personal del enfermo. Pedrote llama a Patricia para que presencie en vivo y en directo como atrapan a unos ladrones en la joyería del centro comercial. Es allí donde se cruzan María José y Venancio por primera vez y ella queda impactada por el comisario. Purita ayuda a su madre en la limpieza del condominio pero se viste muy sexy y es regañada por su madre para que sea más discreta con la ropa que usa.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Fabián está viendo por la ventana las escenas de amor de Armando y Finita. Se va pero se siente mal y Blanca sale a auxiliarlo Botero se siente mal | no habla. Blanca trata de ayudarlo pero al final lo deja irse Finita trata de convencer a Armando de que no se vaya pero el no se deja convencer y se va. Carolina va donde Juan Diego y comienza a perseguirlo para besarlo. Llega Yubiri y el le tapa la boca a Carolina y la esconde. Cuando se va Yubiri Carolina lo insulta.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Amada le pide a Germán que mate a Enzo y a Milagros. Germán acepta y va a comentarle a Willy, pero él no acepta la idea de matar a nadie. Eulalia los encuentra y le pregunta a Germán por los teléfonos. Él le miente diciéndole que los tenía porque los estaba arreglando, pero Eulalia no le cree. German se va con Willy y Eulalia los sigue con un taxi. Luego Germán lo intenta convencer de nuevo, pero Willy no acepta y Germán le dice que se retire porque él sí va a cometer el crimen.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Guillermo y Ana deciden, a pesar de ellos, ser amigos para no interferir en la relación de ella con Cristóbal. Venancio le tiene que pedir disculpas a Pedro (Onofre) por acusarlo de la muerte de Diego ya que el comisario no tiene pruebas suficientes. Esto gratifica a Pedro pero al leer un primera plana que acusan al fantasma de la muerte del envenenado del rio, lo enfurece y promete matar a Barrranco por publicarlo, a Clarita y a Patricia por escribir esa nota. A su vez esa nota enorgullece a Nancy porque la escribió su hija, pero esto le trae problemas a Patricia con Pedrote porque él le dio esa información

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Fabián no le habla a Finita | solamente la ve. Ella trata de inventar cosas pero el no le habla. Le pasa una libreta y un lápiz para que escriba | el escribe y se levanta y se va. Ella lee y se horroriza con lo que le escribió pero le da la razón. En la casa de Atanasio están despidiendo con una cena a Armando por su viaje. En casa de Briggite están hablando de Finita y los cuernos que le montó a Botero. Briggite y Dionisia están de acuerdo pero Carolina no.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena y Gabriel se besan. Están enamorados. Ella no quiere hacerle pasar un mal momento a su hijo. Gabriel está dispuesto a divorciarse de Angie y se lo cuenta a su madre. Valentina sorprende a Epi vestido de mujer y le cuenta a Gloria la historia de la niña que llevó en su vientre. Seis Nueve le confiesa a Julieta que cada vez se siente más atraído hacia ella. Julieta llama a sus padres, pero solo los escucha y no contesta. Zuleica le hace saber a Julieta que Seis Nueve es suyo y está decide irse del barrio. Ana Belén no entiende la actitud pasiva de su esposo con Valentina. Efraín no se anima a confesarle a su mujer, que está enamorado y que quiere dejarla. Deibis está muy desconforme con que Gabriel sea su tío. Toño le confiesa que a él tampoco le cae bien.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo regresa a la casa Tariffi, rompe con Katiuska y reafirma su amor por Manuela. Mientras Katiuska conspira contra los hijos de Ricardo y busca ayuda de criminales, Gustavo es hospitalizado por su grave estado de intoxicación. Marcelo es engañado por María del Pilar sobre un falso embarazo y Elizabeth oculta síntomas de una enfermedad. Finalmente, Ricardo lee una emotiva carta de Celia que lo insta a cuidar de sus hijos y a unirse definitivamente con Manuela.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro abraza a Rosa confesándole su amor, mientras Rosalía los espia y jura vengarse. Adolfo despide oficialmente a Vilma frente a Salvador. Eustoquio cuenta a Arminda haber robado los documentos. Rivero descubre el robo y avisa a Erasto, quien acusa a Alejandro inmediatamente. Marisela se desahoga con Rosa confesándole su soledad. Consuelo y Blanca planifican estrategias contra Erasto. Carmen Rosa le pide a Rosa devolver la hacienda. Natalia advierte a Alejandro que Erasto lo acusó del robo. Erasto entra furioso en la oficina de Adolfo buscando a Alejandro.

Erasto entra furioso en la oficina de Adolfo buscando a Alejandro.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Amada le pide a Germán que mate a Enzo y a Milagros. Germán acepta y va a comentarle a Willy, pero él no acepta la idea de matar a nadie. Eulalia los encuentra y le pregunta a Germán por los teléfonos. Él le miente diciéndole que los tenía porque los estaba arreglando, pero Eulalia no le cree. German se va con Willy y Eulalia los sigue con un taxi. Luego Germán lo intenta convencer de nuevo, pero Willy no acepta y Germán le dice que se retire porque él sí va a cometer el crimen.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Guillermo y Ana deciden, a pesar de ellos, ser amigos para no interferir en la relación de ella con Cristóbal. Venancio le tiene que pedir disculpas a Pedro (Onofre) por acusarlo de la muerte de Diego ya que el comisario no tiene pruebas suficientes. Esto gratifica a Pedro pero al leer un primera plana que acusan al fantasma de la muerte del envenenado del rio, lo enfurece y promete matar a Barrranco por publicarlo, a Clarita y a Patricia por escribir esa nota. A su vez esa nota enorgullece a Nancy porque la escribió su hija, pero esto le trae problemas a Patricia con Pedrote porque él le dio esa información

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Fabián no le habla a Finita | solamente la ve. Ella trata de inventar cosas pero el no le habla. Le pasa una libreta y un lápiz para que escriba | el escribe y se levanta y se va. Ella lee y se horroriza con lo que le escribió pero le da la razón. En la casa de Atanasio están despidiendo con una cena a Armando por su viaje. En casa de Briggite están hablando de Finita y los cuernos que le montó a Botero. Briggite y Dionisia están de acuerdo pero Carolina no.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena y Gabriel se besan. Están enamorados. Ella no quiere hacerle pasar un mal momento a su hijo. Gabriel está dispuesto a divorciarse de Angie y se lo cuenta a su madre. Valentina sorprende a Epi vestido de mujer y le cuenta a Gloria la historia de la niña que llevó en su vientre. Seis Nueve le confiesa a Julieta que cada vez se siente más atraído hacia ella. Julieta llama a sus padres, pero solo los escucha y no contesta. Zuleica le hace saber a Julieta que Seis Nueve es suyo y está decide irse del barrio. Ana Belén no entiende la actitud pasiva de su esposo con Valentina. Efraín no se anima a confesarle a su mujer, que está enamorado y que quiere dejarla. Deibis está muy desconforme con que Gabriel sea su tío. Toño le confiesa que a él tampoco le cae bien.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo regresa a la casa Tariffi, rompe con Katiuska y reafirma su amor por Manuela. Mientras Katiuska conspira contra los hijos de Ricardo y busca ayuda de criminales, Gustavo es hospitalizado por su grave estado de intoxicación. programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Germán ha secuestrado a Enzo y Milagros y los piensa matar pero su madre Eulalia trata de impedirlo. Enzo y Germán forcejean y se dispara la pistola de Germán y como resultado sale herida Eulalia. Germán luego de un tiempo desiste de su intención y se da a la fuga entonces Enzo y Milagros llevan a Eulalia al hospital y alegan que estaba en la calle. Clemencia sospecha de que alguien les quiere hacer daño a ella y a su familia y contrata al policía Braulio para custodie a su hija Gina.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Marilda y Guillermo hablan sobre el engaño de Cristóbal. Barranco interviene en una discusión entre Pedrote y Patricia, Pedrote lo acusa de ser el culpable de que el Fantasma esté libre. Marilda le hace saber a Guillermo que podría contarle a Ana el engaño de Cristóbal con ella. Nancy está visitando a su padre, Conrado; su esposa, Mireya le dice que contratará a Carlota como enfermera, provocando una discusión entre ellas. Clarita se suma al almuerzo con Barranco y Patricia; le informa que Venancio acusó a Onofre de ser un asesino; Patricia lo niega asumiendo que Venancio solo está celoso

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker y todos los del grupo salen para saludar a Yubiri y Solymar. Lolita y Briggite están perdidas en el canal 4. Se aparece Daniel Zarcos y se despiden. Briggite le dice que tiene un sofá en su casa que es famosísimo. Ana y Pastor están caminando por un centro comercial muy enamorados. Pastor le dice a Ana que no sabe que hacer con Mauricio. Ella le dice que tienen que hablar con él antes que otra persona se lo diga. Pastor y Gisela están en el mismo centro comercial.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena no quiere seguir teniendo contacto con Gabriel, ya que esto afecta emocionalmente a su hijo Rodrigo. Es por esto que le devuelve una camiseta que León le había regalado al nene. Magdalena se dirige al hotel donde Agustín se está quedando y lo encuentra con una amante. Nayarí no quiere que su hijo siga teniendo contacto con Gabriel, por lo que le pide que los deje tranquilos. Casualmente Gabriel se encuentra con Deibis por la calle y quiere hablar con él. Efraín quiere tener un encuentro con Valentina, pero un llamado telefónico los interrumpe. Es Julieta, que necesita hablar con Valentina de todo lo que le pasó. Efraín se vuelve a su casa y quiere decirle a Ana Belén que quiere el divorcio, cuando Ricardo toca el timbre, preocupado por el paradero de Julieta.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo lee una carta de Celia pidiéndole casarse con Manuela y cuidar a sus hijos. Katiuska contrata a Renato para eliminar a Manuela. Se descubre que el testamento de la Nona es válido y que Katiuska robó el original, quedando fuera de la herencia junto a Hortensia. Elizabeth asiste al médico y se confirma que su salud no es grave. Finalmente, Ricardo ve un video que prueba la traición de Katiuska y la expulsa de su casa, mientras María del Pilar confiesa que no está embarazada.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Natalia advierte a Alejandro que Erasto lo acusó del robo y le aconseja cuidarse. Isaías y Marisela se prometen abandonar el alcohol pero rompen su promesa. Consuelo cuenta a Leticia el amor incestuoso que Erasto siente por ella. Blanca confronta a Rosa con la verdad sobre su nacimiento, pero ella se niega a creer. Rosalía enfrenta a Rosa preguntando por el beso con Alejandro; Rosa confiesa que el hijo es de Alejandro y Rosalía la ataca golpeándola hasta hacerla caer. Carlos interviene a defender a Rosa, mientras Erasto enfrenta directamente a Alejandro.

Esmeralda, arrepentida por sus errores, le pide perdón a Ricardo, marcando un giro emocional en medio de la ambición y los conflictos por el poder en La Victoria.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Pelusa se envenena ante Alejandro durante el operativo. Carolina da a luz, mientras Xiomara muere en el parto y los Guerrero adoptan a su hijo. La Victoria finalmente alcanza la paz. Óscar halla la Titiguaca en los terrenos de Pelusa. Ricardo y Esmeralda renuevan sus votos, mientras Octavio, que todos creían muerto, los observa desde lejos.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Ortega, esmeraldero avaro y sanguinario, se apodera violentamente de tierras, asesinando y quemando todo. Una familia que trabaja para él halla la gran esmeralda Titiguaca, desatando su odio: quema su casa y mata a un miembro. Días después, la familia Guerrero llega enviada por el banco para supervisar las minas, en medio de un clima de poder y violencia.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Ortega es víctima de un intento de envenenamiento, sin embargo, al no lograrlo, se desata la guerra en la región. También el Padre es expulsado al creer que es él quien ha colaborado en el plan. Al mismo tiempo, Eduardo se empieza a meter en problemas. Ortega intenta sobornar a Alejandro, quien se niega y queda muy indignado. Días después, Olga es rescatada de un violador, gracias a Reina.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: El corrupto alcalde se niega a ayudar tras el intento de violación, pues el agresor es cercano a Ortega. La familia Guerrero intenta huir, pero el banco lo impide. Esa noche, en las fiestas, Alejandro propone repartir ganancias, idea que enfurece a Ortega. Horas después, el Esmeraldero le muestra al supuesto violador para que lo asesine, desatando tensión y dilemas.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: La familia Guerrero busca adaptarse con trabajos, mientras Alejandro se involucra en el registro de esmeraldas para frenar la corrupción, lo que irrita a Ortega. Eduardo quiere dinero en las minas, pero su padre lo frena por temor a su ambición. Reina intenta negociar con su primo para entrar al negocio, pero él se niega a ayudarla.

programme.title: Familiarizado
programme.desc: Dos viejos conocidos del colegio se reencuentran en un bar y sienten una atracción instantánea. Aunque ambos tienen pareja, sus encuentros secretos se vuelven cada vez más románticos mientras deciden qué quieren realmente en el amor y en la vida.

programme.title: Mi Billonario Secreto
programme.desc: Para satisfacer el deseo de su padre, un apuesto y poderoso multimillonario viaja solo, sin dinero y sin usar su nombre real a la ciudad de Nueva York. Cuando el ex playboy conoce a un agente inmobiliario atractivo y con los pies en la tierra, la razón detrás del deseo de su padre se vuelve evidente y ambos descubrirán que el amor verdadero es algo que el dinero no puede comprar.

programme.title: Familiarizado
programme.desc: Dos viejos conocidos del colegio se reencuentran en un bar y sienten una atracción instantánea. Aunque ambos tienen pareja, sus encuentros secretos se vuelven cada vez más románticos mientras deciden qué quieren realmente en el amor y en la vida.

programme.title: Cerco de Terror 26/11 – La Serie
programme.desc: El Coronel Sahota lucha por conseguir mejoras para la NSG. Mientras tanto, la vida en Mumbai continúa con normalidad, sin saber de la amenaza inminente. Parvati, una joven periodista, enfrenta obstáculos para que su reportaje sea aprobado por el canal de noticias.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Una familia de agricultores necesita ayuda para evitar que su granja se convierta en desierto. El equipo muestra a la familia la importancia de no talar árboles y luego despega para luchar contra una tormenta de polvo que se aproxima. Con la ayuda de un nuevo invento de la Dra. Serene, logran evitar que el desierto siga avanzando.

programme.title: Contención
programme.desc: Los vecinos de un complejo de apartamentos se despiertan una mañana y descubren que extraños con trajes protectores los han encerrado dentro. Incapaces de identificar a los infectados de los sanos, los en cuarentena comienzan a cuestionar a las autoridades y a enfrentarse entre sí en una lucha por la supervivencia cargada de adrenalina.

programme.title: Impacto Solar
programme.desc: Cuando los desechos solares caen contra la Tierra provocando una devastación generalizada, la radiación solar resultante provoca mutaciones genéticas en todos los que entran en contacto. A medida que la radiactividad se propaga rápidamente, y con los gobiernos y militares de todo el mundo al borde del colapso, un grupo de amigos se une para huir del caos, desesperados y con la esperanza de encontrar refugio.

programme.title: Contención

programme.title: Diddy: La Caída El Monstruo
programme.desc: El magnate del hip-hop caído en desgracia, Sean "Diddy" Combs, ya no pudo comprar su salida de los problemas cuando un gran jurado lo acusó en septiembre de 2024 de una conspiración de crimen organizado que incluía tráfico sexual, trabajo forzado y soborno. Sin fianza, iba a la cárcel.

programme.title: Cygnus
programme.desc: Un astrónomo detecta una misteriosa señal proveniente de la constelación de Cygnus, a 37.000 años luz de la Tierra. A partir de entonces, comienzan a ocurrir sucesos extraños en el observatorio, lo que lo lleva a una búsqueda desesperada por descubrir la verdadera naturaleza de su hallazgo.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.desc: Josh brings in a man wanted for robbery but loses his reward. A well meaning doctor pays an innocent man to take the blame for his son, but the son sets out to kill the man to make sure he never tells

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh arrives in a town for rest just as the local bank has been robbed. A traveling medicine man knows the whereabouts of the suspect and wants Josh to help because he thinks the suspect is innocent.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: A widow wants to hire/propose to Josh so she doesn't lose custody of her son. Josh served under her husband in the war. His mother now is trying to steal her grandson to take over the family fortune.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: A woman asks Josh, an old friend, to help find her husband Frank - a bounty hunter out to settle a score. He wants to catch a young outlaw who shot him in the leg.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: When Randall has a sheriff bed a prisoner, the man's gang kidnaps the sheriff and two others and threatens to kill one per day until the man is freed.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: In Mexico, Josh is hired to protect a man and his pregnant wife from his the villagers who are angered when he refuses the town healing woman or "witch" from being present when his wife gives birth.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: After Josh takes the task of finding a man and his wife's pet ewe, he becomes the butt of many jokes while cattlemen nearly hang him when he mentions sheep. His only clue is a gold bell the ewe wore.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: When a convicted killer escapes prison, Josh is hired to protect the woman whose testimony put him there. The woman's husband is a lawyer who says he has always been a coward and never carries a gun.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh rides into a town looking for a man who wants to hire him. When he goes to the man's room at the hotel, Josh is shot. He must figure out who shot him but the sheriff is ordering him out of town.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh is hired by Harry Weaver to track down his twin brother Pete, a wanted man. Harry is tired of being used by Pete, plus the law and bounty hunters are apt to mistake him for Pete.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh is called in to track down a new outlaw, the local sheriff who is a friend. The good sheriff who was seduced into robbing a bank by his girlfriend, convinces Josh to let him assist in her capture

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh takes a job protecting a deaf teenage girl and keeping everyone off the father's place for a day or two. Although initially bored, Josh starts to develop a relationship with the friendly girl.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh escorts a photographer to take a picture of his friend El Gato, who is a hilarious bandit living in the hills of Mexico with a small army. However, El Gato is new to photographs and leery.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: A broke Josh is hired by a fearful man to help him elope with his sweetheart, Jane, the daughter of a local rancher. The girl's father is vehemently opposed to the marriage.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh takes a job protecting an express office employee who stole $10,000 and wants to return it before it's discovered missing. However, he had an accomplice and does not know where the accomplice is.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: It’s still opening week of bow season in Oklahoma and the crew has three tags left to fill.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are in Missouri at the Raven and they are ready to burn some powder and get rifle season kicked off at the Raven.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy is at home on the Raven planting food plots and trying to get everything on the farm ready for fall.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are on the Raven in Missouri trying to plant 50 acres of Big Tine food plots in 5 days before heading out west to kick off the hunting season.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy and his brother Cody are at the Dirty Bird ranch in Oklahoma doing some summer time maintenance and trying their best to control the hog population by doing a little hog hunting.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are still at the Raven in Missouri trying to finish planting 50 acres of Big Tine food plots in 5 days. Then Randy heads to the Powder River in Montana and tries to knock down his first buck of the 2025 season.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy is in Oklahoma at the Dirty Bird ranch trying to take down a buck with his new Thompson Center Muzzleloader.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: A collection of the fish that didn't make the cut for an episode, so they get their own episode.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: A look back at the favorites of Season 3.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: Capt. Blair meets up with Capt. Ron Ryals to fish the phosphate pits of Bienville outdoors, an amazing spot for hunting and trophy bass catching.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: Capt. Blair goes back to Marco Island with Capt. Chris Broome to tackle the beautiful inshore spots before heading offshore the next day.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The Local Knowledge crew heads to Catalina Island off the coast of Southern California to participate in the 2024 War Heroes On Water tournament. This event offers a unique opportunity for the sport fishing community to create meaningful connections with our nation's heroes while raising awareness of the challenges they sometimes face when transitioning back to civilian life. With a little bit of luck and a lot of teamwork, Ali and Rush hope to put their veterans on a Bluefin tuna bite they won't forget!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Rush takes up an invite from good friend and fellow guide Jared Cyr to sight fish for barracuda and bonefish in the shallow waters of the Florida Keys. Meanwhile Rush's boat takes a break from charter fishing to get a new Seakeeper RIDE system installed.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a great trip fishing the flats, Rush returns the favor and extends an invite to friend Jarred Cyr fishing offshore. Fishing in Key West is all about the variety of species and opportunities they present. Mixing it up and taking advantage of this, the guys decide to see how many species they can catch using light spin and fly tackle offshore.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The LK crew returns to Guatemala with more friends for our yearly dose of world class fishing! Year after year, Casa Vieja Lodge continues to impress with daily shots at sailfish, marlin, mahi, and tuna. Tag along on our 2nd annual group trip for a tropical fishing experience like no other!

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Marines combat correspondent Ken Plant tells of being captured and tortured as a POW.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: An Honor No One Wants: A Gold Star Family is the immediate family member(s) of a fallen soldier who died while serving in a time of conflict. Sheila Mitchell-Murphy honors the memory her Son…American hero Etienne Murphy.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: 82 year old Navy veteran with more than 2.7 million TikTok followers, Patriotic Kenny talks of how he helps other vets through him gifting mobility scooters to fellow veterans in need.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Army veteran Domingo Martinez recounts overcoming the life altering effects of trauma he received as a child and on the DMZ.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Establishing themselves just after the last Ice Age, the blacktail of Vancouver Island offers an important genetic population isolated from the mainland. To explore the local relationship with the species, its harvesting, conservation and history, Dan Cabela travels to the island.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Dan Cabela sets out to learn about the model of private ownership of wildlife in South Africa. Along the way, he participates in game capture, attends an auction and hunts to support a community.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Dan Cabela dives into the heart of one of the world’s largest game reserves - the Selous. He explores the synergy between hunting and conservation that is preserving this wild paradise.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Join Dan Cabela in New Zealand's breathtaking landscapes as he hunts non-native species, delving into the crucial role of controlled harvesting and the complexities of managing introduced wildlife.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: We listen to guides and anglers on how they attempt to hook into the migrating tarpon that pass thru PCB’s beautiful beach waters each summer. It’s a lesson in humility, respect and yes....luck.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt Justin says you can catch a redfish 365 days in Panama City Beach. We put those words to the test!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade, Ryan and Bearcub take on the midwest! After some tough hunting, the group is able to make a move to get in position on a BIG midwestern gobbler! Bearcub was able to harvest him after working the bird for almost 45 minutes! Slade and Ryan also do some Pre-Deer season work, and establish where the fall food-plots will be!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man Season 3, Slade puts in some early summer farm work to Ensure his target bucks are well fed! Slade also Talks about his Target buck for the year, "Pope"! Slade is laying the trap early in hopes "Pope" makes a mistake early!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Slade and the crew are finally able to catch up with these elk despite some pretty terrible weather conditions. It comes right down to the wire! Don’t miss it.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. - Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves. - As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field. - With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Follow TTHA President/CEO Christina Pittman and her husband Matt this week as they tag along side Dr. James Kroll for his annual deer day! This is a great opportunity to learn from one of the best. We are blessed to be able to share his knowledge with other like minded outdoor enthusiasts.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Join us for an unforgettable Women Go Hunting experience at Legends Ranch in Michigan!

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: John Sewell has played a huge part in the development of feeding Fortified Cottonseed 365 days a year. Laramie Barrett of Fortified Cottonseed joins John for a great weekend of hunting at his ranch in Uvalde, Texas. This is a great time for Laramie to get away from the office and see the first hand of how their product is performing.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed today to hunt with Cole Dutton for the Inaugural Pierce Dutton Memorial Hunt. We are honored to spend a weekend with Cole and his family at the G2 Ranch. Disabled Outdoorsman has played a huge part in getting those less fortunate outdoors. We are truly blessed to be able to follow along and capture these great moments.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor launch out of Key Largo and fish their way up a creek filled with monsters.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Captain Tony Young for a day of offshore fishing and free diving out of Islamorada.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head deep into the Everglades to target snook in the murky waters of Lake Ingraham.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor use Lowrance Active Target all day to find fish, first targeting bridge tarpon then finding a variety of species in Florida Bay mullet muds.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor chase Tarpon of all sizes around Florida Bay and the Everglades.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor catch spotted sea trout and jacks on the grass flats and potholes in Florida Bay.

programme.title: Captain's Log
programme.desc: Capt. Jonathan Moss is in Crystal River, Fl, taking the Cayo out into the Gulf in search of Shallow Water Grouper.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.title: Road Trip Angler
programme.desc: In this episode of Road Trip Angler, Jameson Redding is exploring St. Marks, Florida, along with his friend Chris Funk trying to catch a species of Bass that is unique to the area.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: We are in Marathon, the heart of the Florida Keys, where crystal-clear waters meet charming island vibes. Known for its pristine dive sites, rich marine life, and welcoming locals, Marathon offers some of the best underwater adventures in the world.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: In Episode 3, Josh starts off in the Twin Cities where he meets up with Yia Vang, an award-winning Hmong chef and restaurant owner, bringing his family’s traditions and flavors to the American Midwest. As Josh heads up north to Duluth and the boundary waters, he’ll meet plenty of farmers and foragers—harvesting mushrooms, wild rice, and catching a few fish (and waves) along the way. It all wraps up with an epic feast hosted by Yia back in the cities.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the sparsely populated country of Namibia, in southern Africa, Dan Cabela visits conservationist Robin Hurt to see how private land ownership and hunting have restored the landscape to a thriving wildlife area.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff venture deep into Maine’s backcountry with their buddy Chuck, ice fishing remote lakes only reachable by snowmobile. Their journey ends at the legendary “ghost trains,” a pair of abandoned locomotives that now rest as silent monuments to a forgotten logging era.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: We highlight organizations and programs making a difference in the Florida Keys. Learn how they help protect and restore these vital ecosystems.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: In Episode 10 Boat Trader heads to central Texas to explore boating culture in the lone star state. Second only to Alaska in size, Texas is known as the place where everything is bigger. From big college football games to endless oil fields and vast wind farms, Texas is home to more than 30 million Americans. But the state is about more than just big oil, college football and cattle farms - it's also home to some of the best boating in the country. Boasting a myriad of waterways, boaters here enjoy hundreds of lakes, rivers and streams that provide recreational opportunities, abundant wildlife and plenty of fishing. From Austin Texas to San Antonio host Ryan McVinney and the Boat Trader crew explore the laid-back Texas lake life including boat up restaurants along the Colorado River, watersports in Austin and the history of the waterways throughout the region. Boat manufacturers highlighted in this episode are Tige Boats and ATX Surf Boats, two premium Texas-based wake boat brands known for their high-quality, cutting-edge vessels that come equipped with advanced wake shaping technologies and equipment ideal for water skiing, wake surfing and wakeboarding. There's even a wake surfing dog!

Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: Could dinosaurs still walk the Earth? Deep in the Congo, legends say yes. In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green investigates the chilling reports of Mokele-mbembe, a dinosaur-like creature said to inhabit the remote swamps of the Congo Basin. We dive into real expedition footage, indigenous stories, and eyewitness accounts that all point to one shocking possibility: something ancient may still be alive in the heart of Africa. From early missionary reports in the 1900s to modern explorers risking their lives to chase the unknown, we piece together the long-standing mystery surrounding alleged dinosaur sightings in Africa. Whether you're into cryptids, paleontology, or just love a good wilderness mystery, this episode will have you questioning what’s really hiding in the unexplored corners of the Earth.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In 2003, Brett Mann and two friends were stranded in the flooded wilds of northern Australia. When Brett swam for help, he was taken by a massive crocodile. But the true horror came next. For nearly 24 hours, the crocodile returned—again and again—carrying Brett’s body, circling the tree where his friends clung to life. It wasn’t just hunting. It was showing them something. Was this predator defending its territory? Sending a message? Or acting with something more than instinct? - In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we examine the terrifying true story of Brett Mann—and ask: - When nature strikes back… is it ever personal?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. A fisherman off the coast of Chile is taken by a breaching whale. A diver vanishes into darkness and finds himself trapped inside the mouth of a humpback whale. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean. - These are not legends. These are real people telling their stories. - We also revisit one of the most powerful moments in the Bible. The story of Jonah. Scripture tells us that God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah for a divine purpose. Could something like that still happen today? What does science say about surviving inside a whale? And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?

programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.
